caption: The drawing depicts a single statue of a figure standing upright on a rectangular gray base. The figure has brown skin and long black hair, and is dressed in a short, red dress with a yellow and light brown collar, accented with a yellow stripe along the hem. The figure wears a yellow and gold headdress with three large feathers—one red, one green, and one yellow—extending upward. Across the chest, the figure has what appears to be a gold necklace, and in the left arm holds a bundle resembling a sheaf of leaves and a red flower. The right arm is bent and holds a cylindrical, textured object that is brownish in color. The entire statue is rendered in shades of red, brown, yellow, green, and gold, with some shading to indicate the contours of the carving. The background is plain and uncolored, and the composition is centered on the page.
title: Cigar Store Indian
